Overall they throw on 52.8% of plays [oc1] over 555 plays [oc2], but only 45.3% on early downs [oc3] over 419 plays [oc4]. Their offense is also below average, with EPA per play of -0.08 [oc9], 27th in the league [oc10]. Passing is their best path. Pass EPA is the stronger side of the offense, and their explosive rate on pass plays is only 5.8% [oc11] on 293 plays [oc12], so they do not generate many chunk gains. Play action is used on 21.5% of dropbacks [oc13], and motion on 69.4% of plays [oc14]. Expect the motion to set up the shot plays, and treat play action as a deep-shot trigger. Egbuka is the target focus at 23.4% of targets [oc15]. Designed runs go left 43.8% of the time [oc16], right 38.8% [oc17], and middle 17.4% [oc18] over 258 runs [oc19]. Detroit should set the edge on the left and make the back earn the middle.

Detroit's own absences at corner, safety and receiver will decide how freely the defense can play the Egbuka matchup.
